content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Confirmed, nice. That's the hardest part locked in.

Now worth nailing down: the headcount, so you can get the menu and seating sorted with them, and getting invites out since the 14th isn't far off. After that, think through the run of the night, when people arrive, when dinner starts, any toast or moment you want built in.

What's the guest list looking like so far?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
